SELECT
    o.order_id,
    string_agg(p.product_name, ', ' ORDER BY lower(rtrim(p.product_name))) AS products
FROM {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'order_items') }} i
    ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'products') }} p
    ON p.product_id = i.product_id
GROUP BY o.order_id

SELECT

FROM {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'order_items') }} i
    ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'products') }} p
    ON p.product_id = i.product_id
GROUP BY o.order_id

explanation: This procedure builds a one-row-per-order summary table listing the names of the products in each order, alphabetically and separated by commas. Orders with no line items are left out, because the join requires a matching item and product. If the same product appears on more than one line of an order, its name is listed once per line.
